RouteOutgoingEntityRpc
@ ghidra://SGW.exe@0x00c6fc40
outgoing entity method call

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ServerConnection_StartEntityMessage
@ ghidra://SGW.exe@0x00dd6a60
wire byte = (methodId & 0x7F) | 0x80
_DAT_01ef2630 |= 0x80
then vtable+0x10 writes 4-byte entityId

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ServerConnection_StartProxyMessage
@ ghidra://SGW.exe@0x00dd6980
wire byte = (methodId & 0x3F) | 0xC0
_DAT_01ef2610 |= 0xC0
no entityId write (channel-bound)

[1B: 0x80..0xBF] [u16 WORD_LENGTH]
[u32 entityId] [serialized args]
